name: - RevertFinance
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to _swap, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, single-contract approval-draining exploit that abuses a straightforward arbitrary call/trust issue in the swap utility by passing attacker-controlled token addresses and calldata. The PoC is compact, requires minimal DeFi context, and an experienced auditor could reproduce it quickly once they see the unchecked external call pattern.
